holdings.name: Avalon Technologies Ltd.

what_changed.text: The board approved a preferential issue of up to 19,37,808 warrants worth ₹425 crore to Zollner Elektronik AG.
In the quarter ended June 2026, revenue was ₹484 crore and net profit stood at ₹35 crore compared to ₹14 crore in June 2025.

holdings.why_it_matters: Avalon is the fund's largest reported position at 4.51% and generated the highest 3-month positive contribution of 0.605% on a 13.41% quarterly return.

watch.text: Board meeting scheduled on November 12, 2026 to consider Q2 and half-year unaudited results.
Extra-Ordinary General Meeting on November 21, 2026 regarding the warrant issue.

holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: ICICI Bank reported Q2 net profit of ₹17,389 crore with revenue of ₹55,992 crore.
ICRA and CARE reaffirmed the bank's credit ratings on October 23, 2026.
The bank revised fixed deposit interest rates for general depositors and senior citizens.

holdings.why_it_matters: As the second-largest holding at 3.84%, ICICI Bank anchors the 24% Financials allocation and rebounded 5.77% over the last month despite a -2.61% 3-month return.

watch.text: Movement in deposit interest rates and funding costs.

holdings.name: HDFC Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Sashidhar Jagdishan stepped down as MD and CEO on October 26, 2026, and Anup Bagchi took charge from October 27, 2026.
Net profit for the September 2026 quarter reached ₹21,537 crore on revenue of ₹95,132 crore.
The bank granted 13,02,379 stock options at ₹692.80 per share under its employee stock option plan.

holdings.why_it_matters: HDFC Bank carries a 3.34% fund weight and was one of the largest negative contributors over the past 3 months (-0.247%), falling 7.4% amid management transition.

watch.text: Leadership transition following the appointment of Anup Bagchi as MD and CEO.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Reliance posted Q2 FY27 net profit of ₹29,550 crore with sales reaching ₹330,601 crore.
Jio Platforms completed a ₹30,188 crore IPO and was listed on October 28, 2026.
The board authorized the issuance of non-convertible debentures up to ₹15,000 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: Weighing 2.84%, Reliance detracted -0.31% from fund performance over the past 3 months as the stock dropped 10.93%.

watch.text: Issuance and execution of up to ₹15,000 crore in non-convertible debentures.

holdings.name: Pearl Global Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the June 2026 quarter rose to ₹99 crore from ₹66 crore in June 2025, with sales of ₹1,528 crore.
Incorporated a step-down subsidiary in Vietnam on October 20, 2026 with an initial investment of USD 1.2 million.

holdings.why_it_matters: Pearl Global holds a 2.79% weight and was the second-highest contributor over 3 months (+0.433%), gaining 15.52%.

watch.text: Board meeting on November 5, 2026 to review Q2 results and consider an interim dividend.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: Adjusted revenue for Q2 FY27 reached ₹24,621 crore with B2C NOV up 54% year-on-year and net profit at ₹125 crore.
The board approved an internal Going-out India restructuring and a share swap involving Adonmo and Mygate.
ICRA monitoring report noted zero deviation in the deployment of QIP proceeds.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.54% fund weight, Zomato contributed 0.346% over the last 3 months with a return of 13.62%.

watch.text: Implementation of the internal restructuring and the Adonmo-Mygate share swap.
Regulatory discussions on the gig worker social security board covering pensions and insurance.

holdings.name: Shriram Transport Finance Company Ltd

what_changed.text: Net profit for the September 2026 quarter grew to ₹3,684 crore from ₹2,314 crore a year prior, with revenues at ₹13,792 crore.
The company issued a notice of postal ballot to shareholders on October 30, 2026.
Preferential issue proceeds of ₹39,617.98 crore were reported as fully utilized with no deviation.

holdings.why_it_matters: Shriram Transport was the fund's worst 3-month performer (-21.36%), detracting -0.483% at a 2.26% portfolio weight.

watch.text: Outcome of the shareholder postal ballot initiated on October 30, 2026.

holdings.name: GE T&D India Ltd

what_changed.text: Reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹20,269.8 million and net profit of ₹4,313.9 million.
Order bookings for the quarter reached ₹24.4 billion across multiple project wins.

holdings.why_it_matters: GE T&D makes up 2.22% of the portfolio in the 20.7% Industrials basket; its 1-year return stands at 31.22% despite a 3-month dip of -7.02%.

watch.text: Execution pace of the ₹24.4 billion quarterly order bookings.

holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: L&T reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹78,750 crore and PAT of ₹5,202 crore, with quarterly order inflows of ₹1,477 billion.
Extended the timeline for the share purchase agreement to sell its entire stake in L&T Network Services to Vyoma.AI Limited.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.21% fund weight, L&T anchors core industrials and stayed broadly flat over 3 months (-1.71%).

watch.text: Completion timeline for the sale of L&T Network Services to Vyoma.AI.

holdings.name: Karur Vysya Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Revised Marginal Cost of Funds Based Lending Rates (MCLR) upward by 20 basis points effective October 22, 2026.
Expanded its branch network to 929 branches with eight new openings on October 30, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 2.12% of the fund, Karur Vysya Bank was resilient within Financials, generating a positive 3.99% return over 3 months and 45.35% over 1 year.

watch.text: Asset quality trends following the CEO's plan to tighten controls on gold loans.
Margin trajectories following the 20 bps MCLR hike.

portfolio.statement: HSBC ELSS Tax saver Fund maintains a high equity exposure of 99.3% with its top 10 holdings accounting for 28.7% of the ₹3,974 crore portfolio.
interp: The fund tilts heavily toward Financials (24%) and Industrials (20.7%), followed by Consumer Discretionary (16.5%) and Technology (13.4%).
Recent 3-month performance (-5.35%) was dragged by large financial holdings and energy, partially cushioned by mid-cap industrial and discretionary winners.
portfolio.line: Heavy financial and energy drags outweighed selective industrial and tech gains over the past quarter.

drivers.text: Avalon Technologies added 0.605% in contribution with a 13.41% quarterly gain following preferential warrant issuance.
Pearl Global Industries rose 15.52%, contributing 0.433% behind earnings growth and international expansion in Vietnam.
Shriram Transport Finance fell 21.36%, detracting -0.483% despite higher quarterly net profits.
Reliance Industries dipped 10.93% (detracting -0.31%) despite record Q2 profit and the Jio Platforms IPO.
HDFC Bank declined 7.4% (detracting -0.247%) amid CEO transition.

themes.title: Capital Goods and Power Equipment Expansion
themes.text: Strong order inflows and strategic investments in industrial names are driving operational growth.

themes.title: Banking Leadership and Margin Adjustments
themes.text: Lenders are adjusting lending rates and undergoing top management shifts amid diverging stock performance.

macro.why: Karur Vysya Bank raised MCLR by 20 bps and ICICI Bank increased fixed deposit rates, affecting borrowing costs and spreads.
Pearl Global's subsidiary setup in Vietnam underscores supply-chain diversification.

priced_in.text: High valuation multiples for growth holdings like Avalon Technologies (P/E 103) and Zomato (P/E 662).

could_change.title: Executive Strategy at HDFC Bank
could_change.text: The transition of the MD & CEO role to Anup Bagchi could lead to strategic shifts in balance sheet growth and operations.

could_change.title: Industrial Execution Timelines
could_change.text: GE T&D's execution on ₹24.4 billion in quarterly orders and L&T's ₹1,477 billion inflow will govern future industrial margins.

portfolio.risk_note: High concentration in Financials (24%) and Industrials (20.7%) leaves the portfolio sensitive to domestic credit cycles, interest rate changes, and capex execution speed.
